def compute(index, value):
    value = abs(value)
    if index == 0:
        return int(value)
    q1 = int(value // digits[index])
    q2 = q1 + 1
    cost1 = q1 * (index + 1) + compute(index - 1, value - q1 * digits[index])
    cost2 = q2 * (index + 1) + compute(index - 1, value - q2 * digits[index])
    return min(cost1, cost2)

v = int(input())
digits = [0] * 17
digits[0] = 1
for i in range(1, 17):
    digits[i] = digits[i - 1] * 10 + 1
